description: Sends a mode change to the Madimack only when needed: skips if unavailable or already in that mode; heat requests are held off for 10 min after the previous command. Off is never delayed.

sequence.value_template: {{ hvac_mode != 'heat' or states('input_datetime.madimack_last_command') in ['unknown','unavailable',''] or (now() - (states('input_datetime.madimack_last_command') | as_datetime | as_local)).total_seconds() >= 600 }}
